# aikido_azure_cloud (Resource)

Connects an Azure subscription or management account to Aikido using an existing registered application. Use aikido_team_resource to link the cloud to a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "azure_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Register an application and grant the required Azure permissions first.
resource "aikido_azure_cloud" "subscription" {
  name            = "Azure production"
  application_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  directory_id    = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  subscription_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
  key_value       = var.azure_client_secret
  environment     = "production"
}

resource "aikido_azure_cloud" "management" {
  name            = "Azure organization"
  application_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  directory_id    = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  subscription_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
  key_value       = var.azure_client_secret
  environment     = "mixed"

  organization = {
    management_group_ids          = ["production"]
    excluded_management_group_ids = ["sandbox"]
    excluded_subscription_ids     = []
    acr_scan_enabled              = true
    vm_scan_enabled               = true
  }
}

# Use organization = {} to sync the tenant root with scanning flags disabled.
resource "aikido_team_resource" "azure_management" {
  team_id  = aikido_team.security.id
  cloud_id = tonumber(aikido_azure_cloud.management.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the registered application. Changing it forces replacement.
- `directory_id` (String) Azure directory (tenant) ID. Changing it forces replacement.
- `environment` (String) Environment purpose used for severity weighting: production, staging, development, or mixed.
- `key_value` (String, Sensitive) Client secret for the registered application. Changes rotate the credentials. The API does not return this value; it is stored in Terraform state.
- `name` (String) Display name for this cloud connection.
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription ID. When organization is set, this is the management subscription ID. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `azure_environment` (String) Azure cloud environment: public, gov, or china. Defaults to public. Changing it forces replacement.
- `organization` (Attributes) Connects a management account and syncs subscriptions in the selected management groups. Adding or removing this block forces replacement. Sync scopes and exclusions are updatable; scan flags are create-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organization))

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) Azure subscription ID returned by Aikido.
- `id` (String) Aikido cloud ID.
- `last_scanned_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last scan, or -1 when no scan has completed.

<a id="nestedatt--organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organization`

Optional:

- `acr_scan_enabled` (Boolean) Enable organization-wide Azure Container Registry scanning. Defaults to false. Changing it forces replacement.
- `excluded_management_group_ids` (List of String) Management group IDs excluded from sync. Defaults to an empty list.
- `excluded_subscription_ids` (List of String) Subscription IDs excluded from sync. Defaults to an empty list.
- `management_group_ids` (List of String) Management group IDs to sync. An empty list means tenant root scope.
- `vm_scan_enabled` (Boolean) Enable organization-wide VM scanning. Defaults to false. Changing it forces replacement.

Read-Only:

- `is_management_account` (Boolean) True for a connected Azure management account.
- `organization_id` (String) Azure directory ID of the connected organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import by numeric Aikido cloud ID; supply key_value in configuration afterward.
terraform import aikido_azure_cloud.example 12345
```
